li.label: the warlord is finished
li.description: The warlord who had the colony on a list is finished. I've stopped listening for horses on the road at night.

li.label: the warlord paid for it
li.description: The warlord whose raiders hurt me has paid for it. I still have the scar. It aches less.

li.label: brought down the warlord
li.description: I brought the warlord down myself. People in towns I've never seen will be telling that story.

li.label: the warlord got away
li.description: The warlord whose raiders hurt me just rode off somewhere with a few friends. No reckoning, nothing.

li.label: the warlord was ransomed
li.description: We had the warlord in a cell, after what those raiders did to me, and sold the key back for silver.

li.label: the warband broke up
li.description: The warband that was coming for us has broken up. The roads will be safer for a while.
